name: What factors have the biggest impact on the total cost of a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What factors have the biggest impact on the total cost of a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a full kitchen remodel depends heavily on the room size, whether structural walls are removed, and the grade of materials chosen. Major cost drivers include custom or semi-custom cabinetry, stone countertops, updated appliances, and mechanical trades like plumbing and electrical. Keeping your existing kitchen layout saves significant labor and rough-in costs, whereas moving sinks, ranges, or refrigerators requires running new supply, drain, and gas lines. Establishing your must-have features early helps balance high-end finishes against structural modifications within your budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinetry selections, layout changes involving plumbing or gas lines, structural wall alterations, and appliance choices have the greatest impact on total costs.
